description.value: A tiny, family-run Japanese restaurant that has been serving authentic food in White Rock for over 40 years, founded by Yoshi and Michiko in 1982. The menu spans nigiri, aburi sushi, sashimi, rolls, and full dinner entrees, served in a fully licensed dine-in setting with takeout also available. The restaurant is notably sustainability-minded, partnering with ChopValue to recycle used chopsticks into furniture and home goods.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content at kappasushi.com confirms this is a legitimate, long-running Japanese restaurant at 1450 George Street in White Rock, matching the OSM address and discovered URL. The site explicitly offers dine-in and takeout.
